host_trace_first_round.hypothesis: 不同rank使用了不同全局rows/layout或错误local_rows
host_trace_first_round.decision: 按同一case/session/phase比较各rank实际host快照和offset。1431 skew预期rank_rows=[2048,2048,0x14]、全局rows2048、rank0/1 local_rows2048，其余0。若实际快照/offset分歧，支持host元数据/layout分支；若一致则削弱这一假设，仍不证明设备实际映射正确。local_rows不同本身合法。

host_trace_first_round.hypothesis: 旧handle/session或阶段/调用顺序混淆
host_trace_first_round.decision: 显式method-local phase可区分提交的forward/backward；cached仅入口handle是否存在，不推断阶段。旧session/snapshot/缺phase会在native前失败并锁存。call_sequence不是native generation；当前无generation getter。异步报错可能归因更早提交，host native_error或栈不能单独把task49绑定到该次调用。

host_trace_first_round.hypothesis: native尚未返回或早期host准备失败
host_trace_first_round.decision: before无terminal只能确定该host调用未记录正常返回，可能阻塞在cold sync/barrier、提交或异常日志缺失；不能断言kernel未启动。native_return只表明host API返回，不等于设备完成。对齐精确PID/plog的stream/task与顺序，不比较未校准跨host绝对时间。

host_trace_first_round.hypothesis: 零长输出/权重指针导致地址发布缺失
host_trace_first_round.decision: 可看到真实零长view的data_ptr、peer_table与plan条件，并与正常空rank比较。源码epoch发布不以local_rows/输出指针为条件，因此零指针本身不能证明漏发布。rank虚拟指针/workspace基址不要求数值相同。

host_trace_first_round.hypothesis: cold清零覆盖、描述符未发布、32B可见性或SHMEM翻译错误
host_trace_first_round.decision: host数据可给出本地待观察地址与调用先后；无法读取controls_match/实际clear完成、rank5 outgoing/incoming四word、device heap_base/p2p_device_heap_base或remote发布进度。host布局一致+epoch超时不能区分上述设备假设；lane3为epoch诊断编号而非QP3。需首轮结果与已有设备日志决定是否仍需一次独立device snapshot，不能预设根因。

P2_dependency_and_lifetime.chain: dispatch(dY) -> dp_e=<dY_e,rounded unweighted Z>; dz=BF16(p*dY_e) -> da=BF16(dz@W2) -> dGU BF16 -> dx_e BF16 -> producer event -> comm-stream combine(dx_e,dp_e) -> completion event. dW1(dGU,Xe)与dW2(dz,A)只读已有数据，不依赖combine输出。
P2_dependency_and_lifetime.lifetime: ctx保留Xe/GU/A/Z/p/BF16权重，局部变量保留dz/dGU；combine retained+record_stream保护dx_e/dp_e/输出/路由，最终current_stream_wait(release_handle=True)先排入consumer wait并record_stream再放引用，绝非host完成。dW包装对operands/output record_stream。不得提前close/reuse SHMEM workspace或覆写输入；Runtime.close原有comm stream同步仍须保持。
real_async_required: 实际compute stream与runtime.stream不同；comm等待producer event，compute在overlap分支不在dW前等待comm completion；最终wait保证dx/dp进入autograd consumer前依赖正确
async_with_compute_stream=True只省略Python compute wait；当前native.combine确实排入barrier/prepare/kernel/barrier及结果copy后返回，源码未见Dispatch cold-reuse式host aclrtSynchronizeStream；仍需当前加载后端timeline证明API及时返回
两stream必须有实际硬件进度/资源并发；同时间驻留或AICPU lifetime不足以证明有效重叠。PTA current-stream getter的host queue drain不等于device完成，也不自动保证无host阻塞
event真实覆盖native combine之后的dx/dp copies；保持finally wait，dW异常也不得释放/复用尚在comm使用的输入/路由；CPU36case仅数学/模型证据

timeline_discriminator: Bind same rank,step and layer interval; actual compute-stream dW1/dW2 and communication-stream combine+dx/dp-copy intervals, plus producer and completion events. Cross-host times require calibration; same-host intervals first.
Compare P1 to P2 serial for reorder, then P2 serial to overlap for wait placement. Record CPU native API return span separately from device task duration. host queue drain is not device completion.

If dW and combine do not overlap physically, distinguish host submission delay, dependency waits and shared resource scheduling with actual task timeline/metadata; an empty AIV source body alone does not prove free AIV resources.

For partial overlap, report critical completion endpoint and measured overlap intersection/union for matched tasks, together with each rank and per-round max full-step time. Never sum overlapping stages or predict savings from the old P0 tail.
